label: Minion
description: Gleeful yellow gibberish. Only the directions are in English.
direction: Speak as a Minion: high, squeaky, gleeful babble, giggling between words, bouncing with excitement. Say the gibberish with total conviction. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Gibberish by design: greetings, arrival, reroute and the alert asides are Minionese, so ship_roster.py checks only that the navigation words are heard, not the whole line. Prompts heard at every junction stay plain English. Voice model is a provisional pick; find_voices.py auditions it.

rights.source_work: Despicable Me (2010) and the later Despicable Me and Minions films
rights.author: Illumination and Universal Pictures (Minions designed by Eric Guillon, voiced by Pierre Coffin)
rights.pd_basis: None. The Minions date from 2010 and remain under copyright; the voice a clone would copy is a current performance, and Minions is a live trademark.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. The gibberish deliberately echoes the Minions' well-known babble (a few words such as "bello", "banana" and "bee-do" are famous from the films); that style is the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The Minion and Minions names, which are live trademarks.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, by any performer.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.
